## Statement of claim for unpaid fabrication work

Pursuer: ⟦PERSON|Džana MacQuern⟧

Defender: ⟦ORG|Thistle Wren Exhibitions Ltd⟧ (the 'Defender')

The pursuer seeks payment of GBP 1,280 for fabrication of the agreed display frames. The defender accepted delivery after checking the dimensions against the approved drawing. The present dispute concerns the final instalment, not the separately ordered lighting equipment.

The pursuer supplied a completion note and offered an inspection of the welded joints. The defender raised no complaint about the frames until after the payment reminder. The later complaint refers to transport scratches visible on the packing case rather than damage to a fabricated component.

The agreed price included ordinary finishing work. It did not include repainting the frames in a different colour after approval of the original finish. The pursuer offered a separate quotation for that change and did not receive an instruction to proceed.

The pursuer relies on the signed drawing, delivery note and final invoice. Each document is identified in the production list. No claim is made for the unaccepted repainting quotation or for inconvenience caused by the delay in payment.

The pursuer's correspondence address is ⟦ADDRESS|44 Rowan Quay, Stirling⟧. Email: ⟦EMAIL|dzana.accounts@thistle-quern.invalid⟧.

Prepared by ⟦PERSON|Niamh O'Kelrick⟧, solicitor-advocate, on 28 December 2026. Paragraph 6.2 sets out the sum claimed.
